title: Release packaging on PR checkouts without local main
problem: tools/package_release.py runs `git bundle create … HEAD main`. GitHub Actions pull_request checkouts are detached HEAD and typically have no local main branch, so bundle create fails with `fatal: ambiguous argument 'main': unknown revision or path not in the working tree.` Distribution CI (`make dist`) is red on PRs even when validate/pytest pass. Push-to-main checkouts still work because they have local main.
desired_outcome: package_release.py build succeeds on detached PR checkouts that lack local main, still advertises packaged HEAD as refs/heads/main so `git clone -b main` works, and restores any pre-existing local main (or leaves main absent) after bundle create. Dist CI gate stays in place.
evidence: GHA PR distribution job: `git bundle create dist/howl-future-works-v0.4.1.bundle HEAD main` exit 128
stderr: fatal: ambiguous argument 'main': unknown revision or path not in the working tree.
validate/pytest jobs on the same PR checkout succeed; only distribution fails
push-to-main validate workflow distribution job succeeds (local main present)
acceptance_criteria: git bundle create succeeds on a detached checkout with no local main
Built bundle advertises both HEAD and refs/heads/main at the packaged commit
git clone -b main of the bundle checks out the packaged HEAD
If local main already existed, it is restored to its previous SHA after packaging
If local main did not exist, it is not left behind after packaging
Existing on-main packaging path still works
Dist CI gate (make dist / make verify-dist) remains in the validate workflow
non_goals: HOWL-002 contribution auto-id files or PR #1
Removing or weakening the distribution CI job
Version bump / release solely for this fix
Altering ZIP archive contents or checksum format

routing.executor_policy: EM-authorized CloudAgent publish-only onto a new branch from origin/main
routing.em_decision: AC unambiguous; R2; publish implementation on fix/howl-003-dist-pr-checkout, not onto PR #1
